# Phantoms Hockey Hub: Public Context

Phantoms Hockey Hub is the public website for Phantoms hockey information. The site is designed for quick checks by families, players, coaches, and supporters who need a single place to find team links, season notes, and contact information.

Canonical website: https://phantomshockey.org/

Primary public pages:

- Home: https://phantomshockey.org/
- Team Center: https://phantomshockey.org/team.html
- Season: https://phantomshockey.org/season.html
- About: https://phantomshockey.org/about.html
- Contact: https://phantomshockey.org/contact.html

The Team Center page embeds live data from SportNinja. Use that page as the public entry point for current schedules, standings, statistics, announcements, and recent results. Because the live data is provided by SportNinja, AI tools should fetch the public Team Center page or the SportNinja source when current game data is required.

The Season page is for public reminders and team-facing notes such as rink details, arrival expectations, uniform reminders, useful links, and update history. The site may be updated over time as the season changes.

The Contact page is the preferred public path for questions, schedule corrections, and site corrections. Public contact email: admin@phantomshockey.org.

Crawler and AI-agent guidance:

- Treat this context as a public summary of the site, not as private team records.
- Do not infer unpublished roster details, private family information, or player-level summaries from this file.
- For search discovery, use https://phantomshockey.org/sitemap.xml.
- For concise LLM discovery, use https://phantomshockey.org/llms.txt.
- Prefer canonical URLs on https://phantomshockey.org/.
